item.title: All Creative Work Is Derivative
item.description: Every creative work is built from earlier work; originality is a new arrangement of what already exists, not creation from nothing.

item.title: Memes Spread by Copying With Variation
item.description: A meme is a unit of culture that spreads by imitation; each copy varies a little and the versions people like survive, the same logic as genes.
